title: Woodpecker TONGUES wrap around their SKULL?! 🐦 #shorts
description:
Gizmo Jr. says he knows every animal secret… wrong again. 🤖
Fizzo brought three animal facts that sound fake but are 100% true. ⚡

Which one got you? Comment below! 👇
Follow for a new mind-blowing fact every day!

#facts #funfacts #didyouknow #animals #shorts
facts_checked: A woodpecker's tongue is so long that, when pulled back, it (with its supporting hyoid bones) wraps around the back and top of the skull.
Much of the white sand on tropical beaches (e.g. Hawaii, Maldives) is parrotfish poop: they bite coral, grind it up and poop it out as sand.
Sea otters have a loose pouch of skin under each forearm where they store food and a favorite rock they use to crack open shellfish.
